name: Alex Mercer
bio.paragraph1.before: I build interfaces that feel alive. My work sits at the crossroads of
bio.paragraph1.after: — from real-time logistics dashboards processing 50K events/sec to GPU-accelerated particle systems running custom GLSL shaders.
bio.paragraph2: With 6+ years of experience shipping production code at scale, I've led frontend architecture at startups where performance budgets and pixel-perfect design aren't trade-offs — they're requirements. I think in systems, animate with purpose, and obsess over the 16.6ms frame budget.
bio.paragraph3: Currently seeking senior or staff-level roles at companies pushing the boundaries of what's possible on the web.
